subject: general
question: Which state hosted the 36th National Games of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gujarat**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Gujarat** hosted the 36th National Games of India.
 
• The National Games is a multi-sport event held every few years among athletes from different states of India.
 
• The event promotes sporting culture and provides a platform for athletes to showcase their talent.
